result.instructions: Tools for Accredible, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many badges and certificates did we issue this month?"; "Search the credentials issued to a recipient email address I provide."; "Which course groups do we have set up for issuing certificates?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Accredible data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run accredible_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run accredible_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run accredible_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. accredible_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: accredible_get_issuer
tools.title: Get the issuer (account)
tools.description: The Accredible issuer (organization) behind the API key: id, name, e-mail, remaining credential credits (certificate_left), language and URL. Good first call. GET /v1/issuer/details.

tools.name: accredible_search_credentials
tools.title: Search credentials
tools.description: Search issued credentials (badges and certificates) with filters that combine with AND, newest first by default. Returns id, uuid, encoded_id, recipient name/e-mail, group, issued_on, expired_on, published state (approve), whether the recipient opened or engaged, and meta. Paging: size + offset (first 10 000 results) OR cursor: when the reply has next_cursor pass it as cursor for the next page (cursor and offset cannot be combined). POST /v2/credentials/search (a read-only search).

group_id.description: Only credentials of this group (accredible_search_groups lists group ids).

recipient_id.description: The recipient id your organization set when issuing.

license_id.description: The custom credential id your organization set when issuing.

published.description: true = only published credentials, false = only unpublished drafts; omit for both.

issued_after.description: Issued on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

issued_before.description: Issued on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

expires_after.description: Expires on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

expires_before.description: Expires on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated_after.description: Updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sort_order.description: Sort direction (default desc when sort_by is set).

offset.description: Records to skip (offset paging, max 9950). Not with cursor.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous reply. Not with offset.

tools.name: accredible_get_credential
tools.title: Get a credential
tools.description: One credential in full: recipient, group, issue and expiry dates, published state, public URL, evidence items, references, custom attributes and skills. The id is the numeric credential id or the custom id your organization set. GET /v1/credentials/{id}.

id.description: Credential id (numeric) or the custom credential id (license_id).

tools.name: accredible_get_credential_analytics
tools.title: Get a credential's analytics events
tools.description: The analytics events of one credential (recipient views, shares, privacy changes, verification and so on) with timestamps. Read-only despite being a POST. POST /v1/credentials/analytics/{id}.

id.description: Credential id (numeric) or the custom credential id.

tools.name: accredible_list_analytics
tools.title: List credential analytics events
tools.description: Account-wide credential analytics events (views, shares, downloads and similar), optionally for a date range, group or department. Paged (default 100 per page). GET /v1/analytics.

group_id.description: Only events of credentials in this group.

department_id.description: Only events of credentials in this department.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_search_groups
tools.title: Search groups
tools.description: Search groups (an achievement such as a course or qualification that credentials belong to). Filters combine with AND; name and course_name match partially. Returns id, name, course name and description, design ids, language and dates. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/issuer/groups/search (a read-only search).

department_id.description: Only groups of this department (must be accessible to the key).

collection_ids.description: Only groups linked to any of these collection UUIDs.

meta_data.description: Key/value strings you attached to the object's meta_data when you created it; matches objects carrying these pairs.

updated_after.description: Only groups updated after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated_before.description: Only groups updated before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: One group in full: name, course name and description, learning outcomes, design ids, language, skills and dates. GET /v1/issuer/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: accredible_search_designs
tools.title: Search designs
tools.description: List badge and certificate designs, optionally by kind or meta_data. POST /v1/designs/search (a read-only search).

kind.description: Design kind, for example badge or certificate.

meta_data.description: Key/value strings you attached to the object's meta_data when you created it; matches objects carrying these pairs.

tools.name: accredible_get_design
tools.title: Get a design
tools.description: One badge or certificate design with its settings. GET /v1/designs/{design_id}.

design_id.description: Design id (accredible_search_designs or a group's design_id).

tools.name: accredible_search_departments
tools.title: Search departments
tools.description: List departments (independent organization units with their own designs, groups and branding). An account-wide key sees all, a department key only its own. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/departments/search (a read-only search).

meta_data.description: Key/value strings you attached to the object's meta_data when you created it; matches objects carrying these pairs.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_get_department
tools.title: Get a department
tools.description: One department: name, description, URL, branding and meta_data. GET /v1/departments/{department_id}.

tools.name: accredible_search_collections
tools.title: Search collections
tools.description: List collections (sets of groups shown together). Filters: ids, name (substring), public. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/collections/search (a read-only search).

public.description: true = only public collections, false = only non-public.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_search_attribute_keys
tools.title: Search custom attribute keys
tools.description: List the custom attribute keys (placeholders such as a grade or date that credential designs and e-mails merge in); useful to know which custom_attributes a credential can carry. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/attribute_keys/search (a read-only search).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_list_skill_frameworks
tools.title: List skill frameworks
tools.description: The skills frameworks (O*NET, ESCO, NACE or your own) enabled for a department, each with its published versions. Needs a plan that includes skills frameworks (otherwise HTTP 403 plan_not_entitled). Paged, max 10 per page. GET /v1/skill_frameworks.

department_id.description: Department to list frameworks for (required, also for department keys).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: accredible_search_skills
tools.title: Search skills in a framework version
tools.description: Search the skills of one published skills-framework version by name or the publisher's identifier (partial, case-insensitive, at least 2 characters). Paged, max 50 per page. GET /v1/skill_frameworks/{id}/versions/{version_id}/skills.

version_id.description: Version id from the framework's versions array.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use meta.next_page from the previous reply.

annotations.title: Search skills in a framework version

tools.name: accredible_list_data_exports
tools.title: List data exports
tools.description: Data exports of the departments the key can access: department, status (scheduled, processing, completed, errored) and download links of completed files. Exports are created in the Accredible Dashboard. GET /v1/data_exports.

tools.name: accredible_get_data_export
tools.title: Get a data export
tools.description: One data export: department, status and, once completed, the download links of its files. GET /v1/data_exports/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_get_team_member
tools.title: Get a team member
tools.description: One team member of the account: name, e-mail and permissions per department. Which members are visible depends on the key (an account-wide key sees all, a department key its own department). GET /v1/team_members/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_issue_credential
tools.title: Issue a credential to ONE recipient
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE credential (badge or certificate) for ONE recipient in an existing group. By default it is created UNPUBLISHED (a draft: no e-mail is sent and no credit is used); publish it later in the Accredible Dashboard. With publish=true the credential is published immediately: Accredible then SENDS AN E-MAIL to the recipient (as configured in the group's e-mail settings) and uses one credential credit of the account; an account without credits keeps it unpublished. A sandbox-mode setting in the Dashboard overrides publish. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two credentials (set credential_id to your own unique id to be able to find it again). No evidence, references, bulk issuing, edits or deletes. POST /v1/credentials.

group_id.description: The group the credential belongs to (accredible_search_groups); it supplies the design and course texts.

recipient_name.description: The recipient's full name as printed on the credential.

recipient_email.description: The recipient's e-mail address (exactly one recipient).

publish.description: Default false: create an unpublished draft (no e-mail). true: publish now, which e-mails the recipient and uses one credit.

recipient_id.description: Your own id for the recipient (maps recipients to credentials across e-mail changes).

credential_id.description: Your own unique id for this credential (license_id); Accredible assigns one if omitted.

name.description: Credential/course name; required only when the group has no course name.

description.description: Credential/course description; required only when the group has no course description.

complete.description: Whether the achievement is complete (default true); false marks it in progress.

private.description: Make the credential private: visible only to the recipient after signing in to credential.net.

custom_attributes.description: Custom attribute values merged into the design, e.g. {"Location": "London"} (keys must exist: accredible_search_attribute_keys).

meta_data.description: Key/value strings you attached to the object's meta_data when you created it; matches objects carrying these pairs.

annotations.title: Issue a credential to ONE recipient
